      • sortedToString

        @NotNull
public static @NotNull String sortedToString​(Map<?,​?> map)
        For use with mappedMatches(Function, Matcher): poor mans comparison - sort the map, create a tostring and compare that. Use e.g. SlingMatchers.mappedMatches(SlingMatchers::sortedToString, is("bla=xxx, blu=yyy"));
